details.description: GPT-5 is OpenAI's flagship model released August 7, 2025, combining a fast general-purpose model with a deeper reasoning mode (GPT-5 thinking) and a router that automatically picks between them based on the conversation. It takes text and image input and produces text output, with a knowledge cutoff of September 30, 2024. OpenAI's own API docs now describe GPT-5 as "our previous model" and direct new use to GPT-6 Astra, and Artificial Analysis separately lists it as deprecated, superseded by GPT-5.1 (high).
advantages: Scores 74.9% on SWE-bench Verified and 94.6% on AIME 2025, per OpenAI's GPT-5 launch announcement.
Supports adjustable reasoning effort (minimal, low, medium, high) via the reasoning.effort parameter (OpenAI API docs).
With web search enabled, OpenAI reports responses are about 45% less likely to contain a factual error than GPT-4o, and about 80% less likely in thinking mode versus OpenAI o3.
Supports function calling through the Responses and Chat Completions APIs (OpenAI API docs).
disadvantages: OpenAI's own API documentation now labels GPT-5 "our previous model" and recommends GPT-6 Astra for new use.
Artificial Analysis lists GPT-5 (high) as deprecated and now benchmarks only its default 10k-input-token configuration.
Knowledge cutoff of September 30, 2024 (OpenAI API docs).
Output is text only; the model does not generate images, audio or video (OpenAI API docs).
use_cases: General-purpose chat and reasoning across coding, writing and analysis tasks.
Agentic tool use and multi-step task coordination across external tools.
Front-end code generation and debugging in larger repositories.
Multimodal tasks combining visual, spatial and scientific reasoning input.

sources.title: GPT-5 (high) - Intelligence, Performance & Price Analysis | Artificial Analysis

notes: OpenAI's own docs and Artificial Analysis both treat GPT-5 as superseded as of Sept 2026, but name different successors (GPT-6 Astra vs. GPT-5.1 (high)). OpenAI's deprecations page schedules the gpt-5-2025-08-07 snapshot for shutdown Dec 11, 2026 (replacement gpt-5.6-sol), earlier than the catalog's deprecation_date fact (2027-02-09); kept the catalog's date but flagging the discrepancy. openai.com blocked direct fetches (403); the introducing-gpt-5 page was read via a text-extraction proxy (r.jina.ai) but content and benchmark numbers matched independently-searched figures.
